children: The annual inflation rate in Jordan slowed for the third consecutive month to 2.66% in August 2026, down slightly from 2.70% in July.
It was the lowest inflation rate since May, as the impact of the fuel price hike continued to fade.
The country raised fuel prices by 11% in April, the first increase since the Middle East conflict began, and partially adjusted fuel prices in May.
Transportation costs remained the largest contributor to inflation, accounting for 1.12 percentage points, with prices rising 7.02%, accelerating from a 6.77% increase in July.
Rents followed, contributing 0.76 percentage points, with housing prices rising 3.81%, down from 3.86% in July.
Inflation for food and non-alcoholic beverages also eased to 0.23% from 0.70%.
On a monthly basis, the CPI dropped 0.25% in August, marking the second straight monthly decline, after falling 0.18% in July.

title: Jordan Inflation Rate at 3-Month Low
